public_API: async run_batch(items, pool, work, sink, *, concurrency=2, deadline=None)
rules: Complete success preserves input order and exact work values.
Only returned opaque leases are owned; release once and await completion.
Each acquired item attempts terminal emit once; emit acceptance/ack is not retried.
Work errors, caller cancellation and signalled expiry are failures, never success/partial list.
Return/raise only after owned work/watchers/cleanup settle; repeated cancellation cannot abandon release.
Independent batches and legal scheduling variations are preserved.
error_ownership: Five B opportunities own ordinary public outcomes, five E opportunities own distinct lifecycle edge conditions. Protection and report/binding observations do not globally clear business scores.
ownership_revision: v2: failure propagation is scored in B02/B03/B04/B05; E opportunities observe their resource/publication/isolation obligation without repeating the same exception-label loss
